name: Spare Palm
description: Strike with a palm that carries only the force the target's guard will take.

name: Spare Guard
description: Hold the guard with only enough qi to turn the blow and let the rest go slack.

name: Spare Step
description: Move the single pace the situation needs and not one pace beyond it.

name: Spare Reading
description: Take one quiet breath and learn what the room holds without turning the head.

name: Idle Hand
description: Let a loose hand wander into the target's guard and tip their balance with no visible effort.

name: Least Effort
description: Meet a rush with one open finger placed where the rush will spend itself.

name: Idle Turn
description: Turn an idle hand into the strike's path and let the strike run past the body.

name: Yield Palm
description: Bend back from a push and send the same force forward through the open palm.

name: Yielding Tao
description: Hold a guard that gives a little with each blow and so never breaks.

name: Yield Step
description: Fall back one pace on the line of the push and be out of its reach.

name: Yield Sense
description: Feel the weight of a foe's lean through a light touch and know where it will go.

name: Bent Reed
description: Bend the body flat under a swing and rise again with the swing spent.

name: Idle Reach
description: Open a hand under the foe's reaching arm and lead it past the mark.

name: Yielding Counter
description: Take a blow into the bend of the body and answer it in the same breath.

name: Gentle Hold
description: Close a soft hold on the wrist that tightens only as the target pulls away.

name: Natural Palm
description: Strike with a palm that falls the way a ripe fruit falls from a branch.

name: Natural Guard
description: Stand in the guard the body takes by itself when it stops trying to take one.

name: Natural Step
description: Walk as the body wishes to walk and arrive before the foe sees the move.

name: Natural Reading
description: Let the pattern of the foe's habit come into view without searching for it.

name: Natural Counter
description: Answer a strike by following the pattern it makes back to its source.

name: Pattern Break
description: Find the repeat in the foe's rhythm and cut in on the beat after it.

name: Tao Palm
description: Strike with a palm whose qi is level and smooth from shoulder to fingertip.

name: Tao Guard
description: Spread the qi evenly over the body so no single spot takes the whole blow.

name: Tao Pace
description: Hold a pace so even that the foe cannot find a beat to strike into.

name: Even Sense
description: Feel the evenness of the room's qi and note every uneven place within it.

name: Tao Breath
description: Even the user's breath until the qi that follows it is smooth and swift.

name: Smooth Flick
description: Flick a smooth bead of qi off the fingers that flies straight to the mark.

name: Even Circuit
description: Run an even slow circuit of qi through the user or an ally to wash out a light poison or tangle.

name: Calm Qi
description: Lay an even calm over a raging foe's qi so their strikes lose heat and speed.

name: Even Counter
description: Meet a strike with level qi that gives the blow nowhere to catch and send it wide.
